guide.json.title: Immich SSO with Casdoor: OAuth Login Setup
guide.json.headline: Single sign-on for Immich
guide.json.summary: Immich supports OAuth sign-in with any OpenID Connect provider, in the browser and in its mobile apps. With Casdoor, family members or colleagues sign in to your photo library with the account they already have.
guide.json.redirectNote: Add the first two for every address you open Immich at; the last one is for the iOS and Android apps.

steps.title: Configure OAuth in Immich
steps.text: In Immich, open **Administration → Settings → OAuth**, enable OAuth and fill in:

steps.title: Sign in
steps.text: Save, then open Immich in a private window: the login page has a **Login with Casdoor** button. Existing users can link their account under **Account Settings → OAuth**.

tips: Immich matches OAuth users to existing accounts by email, so give Casdoor users the same email they use in Immich.
**Auto Launch** skips the Immich login page and goes straight to Casdoor.

faqs.question: Does it work in the Immich mobile app?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as `app.immich:///oauth-callback` is one of the application's redirect URLs in Casdoor. The app then shows the same OAuth button.

faqs.question: Can Casdoor decide who is an Immich admin?
faqs.answer: Immich reads the role from a claim named `immich_role` by default. Without it, users sign in as regular users and you promote admins in Immich itself.
